name: graves
caption:
OUR YOUNGEST 🎮🏀 He grew up playing football. Now he's the youngest player on our roster.

• Grew from 6'1 to 6'7 in one summer, moved from point guard to big man
• Santa Clara 2025-26: 11.8 PPG, 6.5 RPG, WCC Freshman of the Year
• 2026 draft: we take Allen Graves at #19. He's 20
• First 9 games: 13.2 minutes a night, 11 points and 6 rebounds at Minnesota

Future starter or long project? 👇

facts.claim: Graves, born July 28, 2006 (age 20), grew up playing football; a growth spurt one summer took him from 6 ft 1 in (6'1) to 6 ft 7 in (6'7), shifting from point guard to big man; 2025-26 at Santa Clara: 11.8 PPG, 6.5 RPG, WCC Freshman of the Year (2026); June 23, 2026: drafted #19 (19th overall) by Toronto
